handoff: Research Handoff 001: Grocery Retailers, Growers and Chemical Litigation
publicationScope: Existing Pollution on Store Shelves section: 16 searchable records and a research JSON download; no separate website

corrections.claim: 226 units sold after Dollar Tree recall notification
corrections.finding: At least 226 three-pack boxes, not 226 individual pouches. Assurance paragraphs 43–47 describe the sales and total.

One WanaBana pouch collected by NYC health officials from a New York City household on November 6, 2023. Sampling date is known; laboratory analysis date is not. Not a Western New York sample or a sitewide average.
Assurance paragraphs 34–35 distinguish 17 confirmed and 23 probable consumption links, with caregivers reporting New York Dollar Tree purchases. These are not 40 Western New York cases.
Official record and original withdrawal letter show withdrawal on October 20, 2026. Retain as withdrawn, not an unqualified active allegation.

corrections.claim: Trader Joe's crunchy almond butter notice 2026-03891
corrections.finding: Official record and notice identify Trader Joe's Peanut Butter with Honey and aflatoxins. The intended crunchy-almond-butter notice has not been independently recovered.

corrections.claim: Trader Joe's peanut butter with honey notice 2026-03890
corrections.finding: Official record and notice identify Simple Truth Organic Baby Kale, Kroger/Ralphs and cadmium. Do not assign this number to Trader Joe's.

corrections.claim: Trader Joe's tortellini is only a notice
corrections.finding: Official record links a complaint filed October 15, 2026, San Francisco Superior Court CGC-26-641988, naming Nuovo Pasta Productions and Trader Joe's. No merits outcome verified.
Original notice product name specifies Raw Argentine Red Shrimp.
Filed complaint includes The Chemours Company FC, LLC in addition to the five companies summarized in the handoff. Verified index 907879-26, Albany County, July 9, 2026.

The 12 concentrations are transcribed as complaint-reported results, with eight described by plaintiffs as PFAS-related. Original laboratory certificate, analysis date and matched EPA tolerance review remain unknown; no confirmed-detection label assigned.

unresolved.finding: Discovery docket index located. Original complaint/current primary docket not recovered; public case number, filing date and status remain unknown rather than presented as independently verified.

Original federal remand opinion verified as 1:16-cv-01921-ESH, Document 17, February 22, 2017. Plaintiffs' August 23, 2018 announcement reviewed; signed settlement and original state docket not recovered. No definitive state judgment or settlement amount asserted.
Records identify the dated complaint, order or notice reviewed. A current complete docket was not recovered for every case; later history remains explicitly unknown.

Official Trader Joe's and Whole Foods Amherst store pages verify retailer presence only. Exact product/lot availability unknown. Assurance paragraph 45 identifies a recalled three-pack sold at 378 Main Street, Arcade, Wyoming County, Family Dollar #5357 on October 29, 2023. Paragraph 46 identifies 15 three-pack boxes released at 821 Culver Road, Rochester, Dollar Tree #7472 on November 5, 2023. Affected Erie/Niagara stores and local illness counts remain unknown.
Individual growers, shared manufacturing relationships and most supplier locations remain unknown; no inference from a brand or named defendant.

additionalContext: Separate November 18, 2026 Driscoll's v. Localize preliminary-injunction order was recovered from GovInfo. It addresses misleading cancer/drift statements, not the merits of the Washington marketing complaint.
WHO mycotoxin guidance supports a scoped aflatoxin/ochratoxin A explanation. The public feature does not transfer general toxicity findings to untested named products.
Minnesota and EPA sources show why structural PFAS classifications must be distinguished; PFOA/PFOS toxicity is not assigned to every fluorinated pesticide.
